faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before we start working together

items.q: How quickly will I see results?
items.a: Most clients see measurable improvements within 2–4 weeks. Revenue uplift typically becomes clear by week 6–8 once the algorithm has enough data to optimize effectively.

items.q: What budget do I need to get started?
items.a: I work with ad budgets starting from $1,000/month. The larger the budget, the faster we gather data and scale winning campaigns.

items.q: Which platforms do you advertise on?
items.a: I specialize in Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube). I can manage one or both platforms depending on where your audience spends time.
Yes. Every client gets a clear service agreement outlining deliverables, timelines, and terms before we start — no surprises.

items.q: How do I stay updated on campaign performance?
items.a: You receive a weekly report every Monday covering all key metrics: ROAS, CPA, leads, and ad spend. I'm also available for calls whenever you need to discuss strategy.

items.q: Can I get a free audit before committing?
items.a: Absolutely. Fill in the contact form and I'll review your current ad account and send you a prioritized improvement plan — completely free, no obligation.
